title: Sanctions List Service
publisher: US Department of the Treasury, Office of Foreign Assets Control
supports: Opened with WebFetch. SDN list and consolidated non-SDN lists as downloadable data files; the Sanctions List Search tool uses fuzzy logic on its name field. No date shown on the page.

title: Frequently Asked Questions: 50 Percent Rule (FAQs 398 to 402)
publisher: US Department of the Treasury, Office of Foreign Assets Control
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Entities owned 50% or more by blocked persons are considered blocked even if not listed; ownership of several blocked persons is aggregated (two at 25% each); control alone does not block automatically; contracts signed by a blocked individual for a non-blocked entity should not be entered into.

title: Recent action 9 October 2026: settlement with Pegasus Worldwide Logistics
publisher: US Department of the Treasury, Office of Foreign Assets Control
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Freight forwarder settled for $175,015; between September 2023 and February 2024 it facilitated the import of a machine supplied by a designated company and failed to fully respond to a subpoena for six months; non-egregious, not voluntarily disclosed. Summary from the recent-actions page; the full enforcement release PDF was not read.

title: The UK Sanctions List
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Only source for all UK sanctions designations; OFSI Consolidated List of Asset Freeze Targets closed on 28 January 2026; formats include CSV, XML and PDF; last updated 3 November 2026.

title: UK financial sanctions general guidance
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Owned or controlled means more than 50% of shares or voting rights, or control by other means (section 4.1); such entities may not be listed but are still covered; a name match does not necessarily mean the listed person (2.2); relevant firms report as soon as practicable (5.1); breaches can lead to prosecution or a monetary penalty. Collection page last updated 12 May 2026.
